diagnostic_targets: Compact deep ribcage behind a short neck and small beaked head with large eye region.
Relatively short thigh and elongated shin/foot support a light terrestrial biped.
Short free grasping arms with five-fingered hands, no Iguanodon thumb spike.
Long narrow balancing tail, no tree-climbing curled tail or kangaroo tail-support stance.
No invented armour, cranial crest, horns or obligatory feather coat.

scale.basis: Current NHM dinosaur directory approximate length. Older GAC2.3m not adopted; no claim this is exact largest known specimen.

scientific_limits.en: Artistic living reconstruction based on NHM skeleton displays and its revised2024bronze cast. These mounted/composite reconstructions are not a complete single untouched fossil; the displayed accession was not established. Two metres is the current NHM approximate length, not a measured individual. Skin, colour and pose are inferred.
scientific_limits.zh: 依据NHM骨架展件和2024修订铜制翻模的完整活体美术复原。装架/合成复原非单件完整原位化石，展件编号未确证。2米取现行博物馆约数，非特定个体实测；皮肤、颜色和姿态属推断。

frozen_scientific_scope.scope: Whole small biped with compact deep torso and long shins. Not skeletal display, tree-climber or miniature Iguanodon.
frozen_scientific_scope.specimen_basis: Actually viewed NHM GAC mounted skeleton photo and NHM2024garden bronze-cast photo with revised skull. These provide broad morphology; accession unverified and not attributed to R197.
